title: Release A, package 3, part 2: one sheet from stocking to the takings; the market, the stalls, buying, the lorry and the night
problem: Between stocking and the takings the market flashes back and the table blinks four times; stocking and the takings are old layouts. The Wholesale Market is a shortened list, not the board's lanes; the customer row grows when walk-ins turn face up; at night two rows vanish and the table jumps; fruit and crates appear instead of travelling.
scope: Stocking, pricing, the bell, the Favoured Trade question and the day's takings as on their boards, on one sheet that stays on the table
The Wholesale Market as lanes of 3, 4, 5 and 6 boxes; the stalls in buying order with what each bought today; the shelf with what tonight does to each piece

The lorry unloads a crate into each lane; a bought piece travels to the shelf; a rival's buying turn is one move; walk-in cards turn face up without moving the table; at night every piece slides one box along and spoiled pieces tip off
A player's awning as a strip over their shelf and a thin strip on their box as rivals see it (DEC-103)
The table rows keep their places from the morning to the night
exclusions: Any rule, balance, save or online-protocol change
The Wardrobe and the stamp book (package 5)
Screen labels beyond those on the boards (package 4, part 2)
"Put out all wanted" or any other stocking shortcut (PLAN-061)
